_comment: Golden table for the shape twin. Identical copy in each repo: work/tests/domain/shape-twin.fixture.json and backend/tests/Anchal.Tests/CommissionerMonitoring/Domain/shape-twin.fixture.json. Each side asserts its own shape tables against this file, so the two cannot diverge without a test going red. Field ORDER is part of the contract. serviceNames is the Hindi service master: the frontend asserts services.json against it, the backend asserts the names MonitoringProvisioner seeds. Renaming a service means editing this file, services.json and ServiceNames together.
